notes.title: Small Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Just released an update fixing a couple of notes that weren't displaying properly, as well as a glitch in the driving level. Performance should be a little better now as well. Thanks for playing!

HAPPY ALMOST NEW YEAR! 
2021 is gonna be wild! Hang in there ya'll!
